description.en: Loads a lighting setup file (.xk) by name and returns its handle.
Internal name for the light setup.
Path to the light file, e.g. "...lgt.xk".
Handle of the loaded light setup.

example.code:
// Load a technique cutscene's lighting setup
hLight = CMND_LOAD_LIGHT("\x008bZ\x0083\x0089\x0083C\x0083g", sBasePack + "lgt.xk");
